decisions.reason: As a line close to the core range that stayed prominently presented for two years, it likely has acceptable performance and low carrying cost, so its option value still exceeds the value of exiting.

It remains on the website after two years but with weaker prominence than Product A, suggesting more mixed evidence, so the firm is likely to keep it while monitoring results rather than drop it immediately.

Because it was launched only in 2024 and is close to existing capabilities, uncertainty about its full value is still unresolved and the cost of keeping the option alive is likely modest for this small specialist firm.
